newsitem.title: USA: No decision on Argentina century bond-Fernandez.
newsitem.headline: No decision on Argentina century bond-Fernandez.

text.p: Argentina's Finance Minister Roque Fernandez said the issuance of a 100-year sovereign bond has been proposed but no decision has been reached.
"We have received several offers for doing that, but we have not made a decision yet," he said in a press briefing after an investment conference organized by Price Waterhouse in New York on Friday.
Earlier in the conference, Fernandez outlined the government's debt management strategy.
He said it included extending sovereign debt maturity, developing the domestic treasury market and diversifying funding sources.
The longest maturity of Argentina Republic sovereign debt, with the exception of restructured Brady debt, is 20 years.
Since last December, Argentina has already raised half of its 1997 international funding needs of $8.5 billion in foreign markets.
